hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the univariate template V(x)*G0(x)*V(x) once with x=p and once with x=q; the original expression is the sum of these two instances.
required_assumptions: V and G0 are univariate function symbols
p and q are independent free symbols
hypotheses.rationale: The two non-identical summands are identical under a single simultaneous substitution p<->q, so they are instances of one multiplicative kernel V*G0*V evaluated at different free symbols.
